# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description

## HTML Description (for `<description>` tag in plugin.xml)

```html
<h2>Flaky Test Detector — Stop Guessing Which Tests You Can Trust</h2>

<p>Automatically track test execution history and identify flaky tests in your project. Each test gets 
a reliability score so you know which tests are stable and which need attention.</p>

<h3>Core Features</h3>
<ul>
    <li><b>Automatic Tracking</b> — Records every test run (pass/fail/error/skip) automatically</li>
    <li><b>Flakiness Score</b> — Percentage-based reliability metric per test</li>
    <li><b>Gutter Icons</b> — Reliability indicators next to @Test annotations</li>
    <li><b>Dashboard</b> — Sortable table with sparkline stability visualizations</li>
    <li><b>Quarantine Mode</b> — Isolate known-flaky tests from blocking development</li>
    <li><b>One-Click Rerun</b> — Rerun any test directly from the dashboard</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pro Features ($5/month)</h3>
<ul>
    <li>Unlimited tests and history retention</li>
    <li>Flakiness trend charts</li>
    <li>Git correlation (find the commit that broke a test)</li>
    <li>Module and package-level aggregation</li>
    <li>Auto-quarantine rules</li>
    <li>Export reports (JSON, CSV, HTML)</li>
    <li>CI/CD integration</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
    <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ (or any JetBrains IDE)</li>
    <li>Any JetBrains-supported test framework</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<p>
    <a href="#">Documentation</a> |
    <a href="#">Issue Tracker</a> |
    <a href="#">Contact Support</a>
</p>
```

## Summary

**Tagline:** Stop guessing which tests you can trust.

**Short Description (200 chars):** Track test reliability with automatic flakiness scores. Gutter icons, dashboard, quarantine mode, and git correlation. Free (500 tests) + Pro at $5/mo.
